sample_unit: datasets (three medical datasets; sample counts not reported in the text)
unlisted_practices: Two-stage training with scheduled sampling to align generated rationales with predictions (reducing exposure bias)
Using LLM-generated rationales for pretraining to reduce reliance on human annotations
Using smaller fine-tuned models in place of large foundation models for explainable decision support

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel multi-task training framework (Reason2Decide) for clinical self-rationalization and triage prediction on benchmark/retrospective datasets; does not evaluate an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
